items: 1 box (18 oz) devil's food cake mix
Cooking spray and flour, for the pan
Powdered sugar or whipped frosting, for topping
Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat a 9x13-inch pan with cooking spray and flour lightly.
Combine all of the cake ingredients and mix until smooth, 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar or frost thinly with whipped frosting.
